capabilities.name: View a calendar month by month
capabilities.description: Open a month grid of calendar entries (attendance, absence, supplement and, in Employee, roster shifts and special days) and move between months with arrows, swipes or a month/year picker. The Manager

capabilities.name: Browse the calendar as a scrolling list
capabilities.description: Scroll a chronological list of calendar entries that loads more entries while scrolling. In Employee the list also lets you jump to a date, open an item and confirm time from a feed item.

capabilities.name: Switch between list and month view of the calendar
capabilities.description: Switch the calendar between a list/agenda view and a month grid. The app remembers the chosen view.

capabilities.name: See the details of a calendar day
capabilities.description: Tap a day to open a sheet listing that day's entries with time or full-day label, title and status. In Employee the sheet also shows the special day and the scheduled roster hours, entries can be open

capabilities.name: Customize what the calendar shows
capabilities.description: Hide weekends, show week numbers, filter entry types and choose icon or text style for events. The choices are saved across sessions.

capabilities.name: Start a time or absence registration from the calendar
capabilities.description: From the calendar list add button, a day detail, a tapped empty day or a dragged day range, start registering new time or absence for yourself with the dates prefilled.

capabilities.name: See what needs attention across modules on Home
capabilities.description: The manager opens Home and sees a greeting with an attention summary, one card per licensed module (Approval, Autopay, HRM) with counts, stat tiles and top items, or an all-clear card; pull-to-refresh

capabilities.name: View an employee's absence balances
capabilities.description: A manager expands Balances on an employee's HRM detail to see this year's vacation balance (normal, additional, transferred, transferred additional) plus self-certification sickness over 12 months and

capabilities.name: See my time and absence balances for a month
capabilities.description: An employee opens a balances summary (vacation, attendance/flex, sickness, sick child) from the calendar, expands rows and adjusts period or future-registration options, which the app remembers.

capabilities.name: See my vacation balances on the start page
capabilities.description: The employee sees a card with their remaining vacation days and taps it to open the balances overview.

capabilities.name: Register an absence or time event
capabilities.description: The employee chooses an absence or time type from a grouped, searchable list of calendar templates (recently used first), fills the server-driven form (dates, full/partial day or definite time, hours/

capabilities.name: Pick cost-unit dimension values for a registration
capabilities.description: While registering or editing, the employee picks dimension (cost unit/project) values from a paged, searchable list with recently used values first.

capabilities.name: View details of a registered absence
capabilities.description: The employee opens a registered absence or time entry to see its type, fields, comment, dates, certificate, dimensions and approval status, with edit/delete offered when the server allows.

capabilities.name: Edit a registered absence
capabilities.description: From the absence detail, the employee edits a registered absence or time entry, including its type and cost units, and saves it through the entry's update link, confirming a future-registration warnin

capabilities.name: Delete a registered absence
capabilities.description: The employee deletes a registered absence after a confirmation prompt, using the entry's delete link.

capabilities.name: See upcoming and ongoing vacation and parental leave on the start page
capabilities.description: The employee sees cards for declined, approved, upcoming or ongoing vacation and upcoming or ongoing parental leave; tapping one opens the absence detail and a grouped card opens the calendar.

capabilities.name: Check in and check out for the workday
capabilities.description: The employee checks in from a start-page/home card at the current local time, sees elapsed time since check-in, and later checks out. A too-short or failed/cross-day checkout routes to editing the reg

capabilities.name: Edit or delete a check-in/check-out registration
capabilities.description: The employee corrects the fields of a check-in/check-out time registration (including a failed checkout), or deletes it, in the shared registration form.

capabilities.name: Confirm worked time up to a date
capabilities.description: The employee sends the timesheet for confirmation up to the suggested date or a chosen date, from the calendar list/feed, the month day detail or the event-type selector. Error-level validation blocks

capabilities.name: Register time or absence by chatting with the Employee Agent
capabilities.description: The employee opens the Employee Agent, types or dictates a request such as 'sick tomorrow', reviews the predicted events and confirms to create them (in parallel), handling extra warning confirmations

capabilities.name: Confirm the time sheet through the Employee Agent
capabilities.description: When the agent reads the prompt as a time-confirmation request, it shows a confirm-time event; on confirm, the time sheet for that date is sent for approval.

capabilities.name: Ask the Employee Agent about leave balances
capabilities.description: The employee asks the agent about balances and it replies with the balance text returned by the prediction service.

capabilities.name: Edit a predicted registration before saving it
capabilities.description: From the agent's suggestion, the employee opens the registration form pre-filled with the prediction (for example to add a required medical certificate for sickness), adjusts it and saves it as a real

capabilities.name: View, edit or delete an absence created in the agent chat
capabilities.description: The employee taps an event the agent has just registered to open its detail, where they can edit or delete it; a deletion shows in the chat.

capabilities.name: Learn how to use the Employee Agent and try example prompts
capabilities.description: The employee opens the info page to read about the agent and see example prompts from the server; tapping an example puts it in the chat input.

capabilities.name: Send feedback about the Employee Agent
capabilities.description: From the Learn More page, the employee opens an external feedback form (Google Forms) about the agent.

capabilities.name: Browse my expense claims by year and filter by status
capabilities.description: The employee opens the Claims part of the Expenses tab, pages through their claims (older and newer) and narrows the list with status filter chips loaded from the server.

capabilities.name: Browse my payslips by payment date, filtered by employer
capabilities.description: An employee pages through past and upcoming payslips from every connected company, ordered by payment date. Each shows company, payment day and net amount. An employee with several employers picks whi

capabilities.name: Switch the active Business NXT company
capabilities.description: A manager with access to several Business NXT companies picks which company every BXN order, invoice, money and approval screen shows, from an initials-avatar dropdown in the header.

capabilities.name: Open a Business NXT work area
capabilities.description: A Business NXT user opens sales orders, purchase orders, offers, invoices, approvals, money in/out or the registers, either from the BXN hub list or from the tabbed workspace. Areas the user has no ac

capabilities.name: Browse Business NXT orders
capabilities.description: A Business NXT user lists sales orders, purchase orders or offers, searches them, sorts by date, number or name, and filters by creator, approval state and invoiced. Tapping an order opens it; from sa

capabilities.name: View a Business NXT order
capabilities.description: A user opens a sales order, purchase order or offer to see its status, totals, VAT, delivery date, counterparty, lines and approval status. From there they can jump to the customer or supplier card, o

capabilities.name: Edit a Business NXT order's references, delivery date and lines
capabilities.description: A user edits an order's delivery date, our reference and your reference, and updates, adds or deletes lines. They can then save or revert, and are warned about unsaved changes.

capabilities.name: Create a sales or purchase order
capabilities.description: A user builds a new BXN order: they pick a customer (sales) or supplier (purchase), add products with quantities, preview totals calculated by the server, and confirm to create it.

capabilities.name: Send a purchase order to approval
capabilities.description: A buyer sends a purchase order into the BXN approval flow, with an optional comment.

capabilities.name: Cancel a purchase order
capabilities.description: A buyer cancels a BXN purchase order after a destructive confirmation.

capabilities.name: Open an order attachment
capabilities.description: A user opens a PDF attached to a BXN order. It is downloaded, cached locally and shown in an in-app PDF viewer.

capabilities.name: Track documents sent for approval
capabilities.description: A user views the Business NXT approval board, with paginated 'In approval' and 'History' segments. They open a task to see its status, document, sender, current approver and latest comment, and can ju

capabilities.name: Withdraw a pending approval task
capabilities.description: From a Business NXT approval task, the sender cancels the pending task after a confirmation.

capabilities.name: Browse and search archived invoices
capabilities.description: A user lists the company's BXN invoices, searches by customer name or invoice number, sorts by date, number, name or amount, and opens the order an invoice came from. A Gaia assist is also available.

capabilities.name: See money owed by customers or to suppliers
capabilities.description: A user opens Money in or Money out to see the total outstanding, the overdue total and the overdue count, plus a paged list of customer or supplier balances to drill into.

capabilities.name: Review an associate's open ledger entries
capabilities.description: A user sees a customer's or supplier's open ledger entries, paged, with the outstanding total, and can jump to the associate card.

capabilities.name: View a customer or supplier card
capabilities.description: A user views a BXN customer's or supplier's outstanding balance, open-entry count, oldest due date, company details, contact info with tap-to-call or email, and contact persons, and can drill into ope

capabilities.name: Look up products, customers, suppliers and stock
capabilities.description: A Business NXT user searches the product, customer, supplier or inventory registers and opens an entry.

capabilities.name: Check a product's stock
capabilities.description: A Business NXT user opens a product to see its physical, available, reserved and incoming stock, and whether it is suspended.

capabilities.name: Ask the AI assistant a question
capabilities.description: A person types or taps a question in the assistant chat and reads the AI answer. Manager: Gaia, a general assistant with streamed answers, tool progress, rich text and follow-up reply buttons. Employe

capabilities.name: Open the assistant for the current screen from the header
capabilities.description: From the sparkles header button the manager opens the Gaia chat scoped to the current task, or to the current module when no task is passed. A status dot shows when a chat is still running, has an unr

capabilities.name: Ask the assistant about an approval task or past approval
capabilities.description: From a task, process, voucher-lines view or the approval list, the manager opens Gaia scoped to that document, or taps a suggested question chip (safe to approve?, approvers, comments, supplier histor

capabilities.name: Ask the assistant about an employee
capabilities.description: On the employee detail screen the manager taps a hint chip (pending tasks for this employee, vacation days) or the header assist button to ask Gaia about that employee.

capabilities.name: Ask the assistant from Home, Home search or a list's search band
capabilities.description: The manager types a question, or taps a suggested question or prompt card, in the Home hero panel, the Home search (when nothing is found) or the combined search/ask band on list screens. This opens G

capabilities.name: Ask the payslip assistant about a payslip or year-end report
capabilities.description: From the payslips screen, a single payslip, a year-end report or a new-feature card, the employee opens the payslip AI assistant, optionally with a pre-filled question.

capabilities.name: Start from a suggested question
capabilities.description: When a conversation is empty, the assistant shows example questions that the person can tap to send.

capabilities.name: Browse the catalog of questions the assistant can answer
capabilities.description: From the chat header or the empty-chat link, the manager opens a catalog of example questions grouped by the integrations they can access, and taps one to send it to Gaia.

capabilities.name: Start a new assistant conversation
capabilities.description: The manager clears the current chat and starts a fresh thread from the chat header or the conversation list.

capabilities.name: Find and resume a past assistant conversation
capabilities.description: The manager opens the conversation history from the chat header, searches past conversations by title and reopens one. Threads still running or with unseen answers are raised to the top.

capabilities.name: Rename, pin or delete an assistant conversation
capabilities.description: The manager long-presses a conversation in the list to rename it, pin or unpin it, or delete it after confirmation. Each row shows its title, last update, company and whether it is running or unread.

capabilities.name: Resume the conversation an answer-ready notification announced
capabilities.description: Tapping an 'answer ready' push notification or toast opens the chat directly in the named thread and marks it as read.

capabilities.name: Rate an assistant answer
capabilities.description: The person gives an assistant answer a thumbs up or thumbs down, or undoes it. In Employee, a thumbs down opens a sheet to pick an issue category and add details, and the rating is sent to the server.

capabilities.name: Copy an assistant answer
capabilities.description: The employee copies the text of a bot reply to the clipboard.

capabilities.name: Open a source cited in an assistant answer
capabilities.description: The manager taps a knowledge source cited under a Gaia answer to open it in the external browser.

capabilities.name: Approve or decline an action the assistant asks permission for
capabilities.description: When Gaia wants to run a gated tool, it shows a confirmation card and the manager approves or declines it.

capabilities.name: Approve or reject an approval task from within the assistant chat
capabilities.description: An approval task linked in a Gaia answer renders as a card with amount, due date, attachments or comments, and the manager approves or rejects it without leaving the chat.

capabilities.name: Open an approval task linked in an assistant answer
capabilities.description: Tapping the task card in a Gaia answer opens the approval task detail screen, or the original link in the browser if the task cannot be loaded.

capabilities.name: Let the assistant navigate the app
capabilities.description: Gaia can open an approval task, the approval list (to-do or history, with a search), an employee's detail, or the start, conversation-history and settings screens, and reports the result back into the

capabilities.name: Dictate a message to the assistant by voice
capabilities.description: The person taps the microphone in the assistant's message field, grants permission and speaks. The transcript is added to what was already typed.

capabilities.name: Switch between the app's main areas
capabilities.description: A signed-in person moves between the app's main areas through a bottom tab bar that only shows the areas their roles or permissions grant.

capabilities.name: Open any integration from the More sheet
capabilities.description: The manager opens the More sheet, sees a grid of every integration they can use with pinned, active and new or badge marks, and opens the one tapped.

capabilities.name: Customize which areas are pinned to the tab bar
capabilities.description: In the More sheet's edit mode the manager pins or unpins integrations, reorders the pinned tabs and saves; newly granted areas are marked new.

capabilities.name: Search and sort a work list
capabilities.description: From a list's header bar (approvals, HRM employees, autopay) the manager opens a search field or a sort panel, a dialogue-type selector or an overflow menu.

capabilities.name: Search across approvals, invoices, employees and orders
capabilities.description: From Home the manager types a query and jumps to a matching approval task, Autopay invoice, HRM employee or Business NXT sales order, grouped by module.

capabilities.name: Open a pending approval task from Home
capabilities.description: Tapping an approval row on the Home card opens the approval task detail inside the Start stack so back returns to Home.

capabilities.name: Open an upcoming Autopay payment from Home
capabilities.description: Tapping a payment row on the Home Autopay card opens that transaction's invoice details in the Autopay tab.

capabilities.name: Follow up on unread dialogues, absent colleagues and new hires from Home
capabilities.description: Tapping an HRM card row opens the dialogue thread or wage-run splits list for unread messages, or the employee detail for someone absent today or recently hired.

capabilities.name: Review recent activity across approval, payments and dialogues
capabilities.description: The Home 'Recent activity' feed lists the latest 8 events from the last 30 days (own approval actions and outcomes, paid or cancelled payments, dialogue replies) and opens each in its module.

capabilities.name: Jump into a licensed module from Home
capabilities.description: The Home Integrations list gives one row per licensed module (Approval, Autopay, HRM, OneStop Reporting, BNXT orders) that opens that module's tab, plus a 'Go to <module>' link on expanded cards.

capabilities.name: Discover and act on What's New announcements
capabilities.description: A person sees What's New cards about new app features on Home, can follow the call-to-action to the feature, or dismiss the card so it stays hidden.

capabilities.name: See personal highlights on the start page
capabilities.description: An employee opens Home and sees a sorted carousel of highlight cards about their own pay, absences, vacation balance, expenses, check-in and messages, chosen by their permissions, with offline, placeh

capabilities.name: Open the latest or upcoming payslip from the start page
capabilities.description: The employee sees a salary card (past, future or none) or taps a 'View latest payslip' quick action to open that payslip or the payslip list.

capabilities.name: Track the status of submitted expense claims from the start page
capabilities.description: The employee sees cards for approved, rejected, sent and unsent claims and for claims whose card transaction changed, was returned automatically or failed to send for approval; tapping opens the claim

capabilities.name: Resume unsent expense drafts from the start page
capabilities.description: The employee sees how many receipts, mileages, allowances or credit-card transactions are still unsent, with totals, and taps the card to open them and send.

capabilities.name: Read important messages, surveys and app-update prompts on Home
capabilities.description: The employee sees a remotely controlled important-info message, a survey card and an app-update card on Home, opens each in a bottom sheet to follow it (info link, survey URL, Play Store) or dismisses

capabilities.name: Start a common task from Home quick selections
capabilities.description: The employee taps a Home quick-selection button to register absence or time, add a receipt or mileage, or view the latest payslip.

capabilities.name: Reach HR profile, documents and benefits or the employee list from Home shortcuts
capabilities.description: An employee who only has the Dottie HR permission gets start-page shortcuts to My profile, Documents and benefits and the Employee list instead of the standard quick actions.

capabilities.name: Open my user menu to reach profile, account and HR pages
capabilities.description: The employee taps their avatar (Dottie photo or initials) to open a user menu with name and email, then switches account or opens My profile, Documents and benefits, Employee list or Emissions summary

capabilities.name: Sign out from the user menu
capabilities.description: The employee signs out from the user menu; the app revokes tokens, clears stored auth data and unregisters the device from push.

capabilities.name: Open a specific app section from a link
capabilities.description: A person taps a verified https app link and lands on the matching tab, payslip or year-end report, after unlocking and onboarding, falling back to Home when they lack the feature.

capabilities.name: Acknowledge a blocking startup notice
capabilities.description: At launch the employee may be shown a non-dismissable notice that must be confirmed before the app continues.

capabilities.name: Go through first-run onboarding
capabilities.description: On first launch or after an app update a person sees the onboarding flow once, after unlocking if a lock is set.

capabilities.name: View a financial reporting dashboard for a company and period
capabilities.description: A manager with OneStop Reporting access picks a company, a dashboard and a reporting interval and sees each dashboard element as a card. A card shows one figure or a line or column chart. Each element

capabilities.name: Choose the customer and tenant to report on
capabilities.description: A manager with OneStop Reporting access picks the customer and tenant that the dashboards report on. The choice is persisted.

capabilities.name: Filter a dashboard chart by category and choose which series to show
capabilities.description: On a dashboard card or its detail screen, the manager picks a category, which reloads the element for the selected interval. The manager also chooses which data series the chart draws.

capabilities.name: Examine a dashboard chart in detail
capabilities.description: The manager taps a dashboard card to open that element full-screen, keeping the current category and series selection. The detail screen shows a legend and lets the manager show or hide value labels.

capabilities.name: Read how-to help for the current screen
capabilities.description: A manager taps the info icon in a screen header (approval list, document editor, Autopay, OneStop Reporting, employee list/details, settings) and reads an info sheet with a title, description and icon

capabilities.name: Browse help (FAQ) by topic
capabilities.description: An employee opens Help/FAQ (from Settings, a payslip route, or a disabled/placeholder start-page card) and picks a topic (Payslips, Expense, Time & Absence, My Profile, Other) to see which of their co

capabilities.name: Check why a module is not available for my company
capabilities.description: In a help topic, the app looks up the license of each company that lacks the module and explains whether it was never activated, is activated, or was terminated/deactivated.

capabilities.name: Send feedback about the app
capabilities.description: A user writes a free-text message and sends it to Visma together with device and app version details, then sees a sent/failed confirmation.

capabilities.name: Send feedback about Business NXT line editing
capabilities.description: An approver writes and sends free-text feedback specifically about the Business NXT line-editing experience, with a discard confirmation when cancelling a draft.

capabilities.name: Rate the app in the store
capabilities.description: After enough qualifying actions the user is asked to rate the app in the App Store / Google Play.

capabilities.name: Answer an NPS satisfaction survey
capabilities.description: An eligible user is shown a 0-10 likelihood-to-recommend survey inside the app and can add a comment and send it.

capabilities.name: Decline the NPS survey or stop it from showing again
capabilities.description: A manager dismisses the NPS survey and chooses Close (decline this time) or 'Don't show again' (turn it off for good).

capabilities.name: Take or dismiss a survey from the home card
capabilities.description: When a survey is active, the employee sees a start-page card and either opens the survey form or dismisses it; the card is not shown again for that survey.

capabilities.name: Volunteer for user testing
capabilities.description: An eligible manager is invited (from an empty list or Settings) to take part in user testing, reads the test description, and submits email and optional phone, or declines/closes the invitation for go

capabilities.name: Review and share failed request logs
capabilities.description: When requests have failed, a manager opens the error log list from Settings, views details and shares an error report via the system share sheet.

capabilities.name: Copy account and device details for support
capabilities.description: An employee taps their email, OS version or app version in Settings and all three are copied to the clipboard with a confirmation banner.

capabilities.name: Read open-source licenses and the accessibility statement
capabilities.description: From Settings an employee opens the open-source licenses or the accessibility statement (from which feedback can also be sent).

capabilities.name: Open app settings
capabilities.description: Open the Settings screen from the gear button in the root header of any integration (OSR, BXN and others), or run a custom handler when the header supplies one.

capabilities.name: Choose the app language
capabilities.description: Pick the language the app is shown in. Without a choice, the app uses the device locale or the default language.

capabilities.name: Choose light, dark or system appearance
capabilities.description: Pick a light, dark or system/auto theme. The app restyles right away and remembers the choice.

capabilities.name: Turn vibration and the holiday theme on or off
capabilities.description: Turn vibration on select on or off and, during the Christmas season, turn the holiday theme on or off. Both are saved to the backend user settings.

capabilities.name: Control anonymous analytics collection
capabilities.description: Turn anonymous usage data collection on or off in Privacy settings. The consent is applied to the analytics SDK, and a Remote Config flag decides whether Snowplow is used.

capabilities.name: Read the accessibility statement
capabilities.description: Open and read the app's accessibility statement.

capabilities.name: Read the terms of service and privacy information
capabilities.description: Read the user terms and data-usage summary, and follow links to the Visma trust centre, data-usage and privacy pages.

capabilities.name: View app version and open-source licenses
capabilities.description: See the app version and build, and browse the third-party libraries and their licenses.

capabilities.name: See the signed-in account and device info in Settings
capabilities.description: See the login e-mail, the OS version and the app version/build in an info block at the top of Settings.

capabilities.name: Allow or block screenshots of the app
capabilities.description: Turn screenshots and screen capture of app content on or off. The choice is stored as a preference and applied through the window secure flag.

capabilities.name: Update the app when a new version is suggested or required
capabilities.description: At launch or after login the app checks a backend config. It then suggests or forces a store update, or tells the user to update the OS.

capabilities.name: Keep app state after restarting or updating the app
capabilities.description: Settings, login, terms, surveys, HRM, Autopay, OneStop, recent approval searches, Gaia chats and What's New state survive restarts in encrypted storage. State from the old storage format is imported o

capabilities.name: Use internal developer tools and feature flags
capabilities.description: In stage or test builds, internal users toggle feature flags and use debugging tools such as push device management, test notifications, forced crashes or PIN, and survey reset.

capabilities.name: Switch backend environment in test builds
capabilities.description: In test builds a tester picks which backend environment (API and Connect URLs) the app talks to. Production builds always use production.

capabilities.name: See that an employee's birthday is coming up
capabilities.description: A manager sees a cake badge on the HRM tab, a birthday/anniversary badge on list rows and a days-until countdown on the employee profile when an employee's birthday or work anniversary is within 10 da

capabilities.name: Turn birthday and work-anniversary reminders on or off
capabilities.description: A manager with HRM access switches reminders for employee birthdays and work anniversaries on or off in Settings.

capabilities.name: Browse the employee directory
capabilities.description: A person opens the employee directory and scrolls through the people they can see, pulls to refresh, and taps a person to open their profile. In Manager the list covers the manager's employees across

capabilities.name: Search the employee directory by name
capabilities.description: A person types a name in the directory search bar to narrow the list.

capabilities.name: Filter the employee directory with quick filters
capabilities.description: A person taps a quick-filter chip (for example same leader, department or country) to narrow the directory, and taps it again or Show all to clear it.

capabilities.name: Hide or show companies in the employee list
capabilities.description: With the Dottie integration on, a manager ticks or unticks companies in the overflow menu to hide or show them. Showing a company again scrolls the list to it.

capabilities.name: View an employee's personal, address and employment details
capabilities.description: A manager opens an HRM employee and expands accordion sections to read personal details, post address and current position (employee id, position type, employment date, start/end, form, work type, wor

capabilities.name: View a colleague's Dottie profile
capabilities.description: A person opens a Dottie-sourced employee from the directory and reads their profile photo, name, job and organization details, contact, employment dates, manager and location, read-only.

capabilities.name: Contact an employee by call, SMS, email or share
capabilities.description: From the employee detail header or any phone or email field, a manager calls, texts, emails or shares the employee's contact value through the device apps.

capabilities.name: Copy an employee's post address
capabilities.description: A manager copies the employee's full post address (street, city, zip, localized country) to the clipboard.

capabilities.name: Edit an employee's name, phone numbers and emails
capabilities.description: A manager taps Edit on an employee's personal details, updates first and last name, business and private phone and email, and saves them to the HR system.

capabilities.name: Edit an employee's postal address
capabilities.description: A manager taps Edit on the post address section and updates street, postal code, city and country (from a searchable picker) for an employee.

capabilities.name: Add or edit an employee's child
capabilities.description: A manager sees an employee's children sorted by name. They tap Add child to register a new one (name, year of birth, sole custody), or open one to edit it from a read-only view.

capabilities.name: Remove an employee's child
capabilities.description: A manager removes a child from an employee's relatives.

capabilities.name: Add or edit an employee's emergency contact
capabilities.description: A manager sees an employee's non-child relatives as emergency contacts. They add a new one or open one to edit it (name, phone, email, main contact flag), with tappable phone and email in the read-onl

capabilities.name: Remove an employee's emergency contact
capabilities.description: A manager deletes an emergency contact from an employee's record.

capabilities.name: Generate an AI birthday or work-anniversary greeting
capabilities.description: When an employee's birthday or milestone work anniversary is within 10 days, a manager taps Create greeting on the employee profile or a celebration row on the Home HRM card. The bot writes a message

capabilities.name: Send a greeting to the employee by share sheet or SMS
capabilities.description: A manager edits the generated greeting and sends it through the system share sheet or an SMS pre-filled with the employee's phone number.

capabilities.name: Save a greeting for later
capabilities.description: A manager stores the greeting, edited or not, against the employee and returns to their profile.

capabilities.name: View my personal information
capabilities.description: An employee opens Personal Information to see their email, business and private phone, address, bank account or cash payment, tax table and tax percentage, and their emergency contacts and children. F

capabilities.name: Update my phone numbers and home address
capabilities.description: An employee edits their business and private phone, street, zip code and city, picks a country from a searchable list, and saves the changes to their payroll/HR record. A slow backend shows an 'update

capabilities.name: Change my salary bank account number
capabilities.description: An employee paid by bank transfer, whose company grants the change-bank-account permission, edits their salary bank account number and saves it. Otherwise the field is read-only.

capabilities.name: Add an emergency contact or child
capabilities.description: An employee adds a relative (partner, contact person or child) with name, email, phone and main-contact flag. For children they also enter date of birth, sole custody and a chronic illness period. The

capabilities.name: Edit an emergency contact or child
capabilities.description: An employee opens an existing relative, changes its details and saves them to their employee record.

capabilities.name: Remove an emergency contact or child
capabilities.description: An employee deletes a relative from their personal information.

capabilities.name: View and update my HR profile
capabilities.description: An employee in a Dottie company opens their own HR profile, a server-template-driven form (names, contacts, addresses, bank accounts, children, next of kin and more). They edit the allowed fields and

capabilities.name: Change or remove my profile picture
capabilities.description: An employee takes a photo or picks one from the library, crops it to a circle and uploads it as their HR profile picture, or deletes the current picture after confirming.

capabilities.name: Pick and crop a profile picture (prototype)
capabilities.description: A prototype reachable only from developer tools lets a person choose a gallery photo cropped to a circle. The image is not saved or uploaded.

capabilities.name: See my pending approval tasks
capabilities.description: A manager opens the Approval tab and sees their inbox of open approval tasks (invoices, expenses, other) with amounts, due/overdue badges and optional company grouping with collapsible groups. They pu

capabilities.name: Sort approval tasks
capabilities.description: A manager orders the task list by company, document due date or task due date; the choice is remembered.

capabilities.name: Search approval tasks and history
capabilities.description: A manager searches pending tasks or history by free text (or asks Gaia), reuses recent searches, or swipes a history row to search everything from the same requester.

capabilities.name: Review an approval task
capabilities.description: A manager opens one pending task to see its document, company, amount or hours/days, due dates, workflow and Gaia hints, and acts on it from the task actions.

capabilities.name: Approve an approval task
capabilities.description: A manager approves a task with an optional comment (up to 400 characters, saved as a draft) in the action drawer, from the task detail, by swiping a list row (quick approve), or directly from the docu

capabilities.name: Reject an approval task
capabilities.description: A manager rejects a task, giving a mandatory comment.

capabilities.name: Complete a review of a task
capabilities.description: A reviewer marks a task sent to them for review as reviewed, with a mandatory comment.

capabilities.name: Send a task for review to a colleague
capabilities.description: A manager picks a colleague from the process's user list and sends the task to them for review with a mandatory comment.

capabilities.name: Forward a task to another approver
capabilities.description: A manager hands the task over to another user of the process with a mandatory comment.

capabilities.name: Act on an approval task from the Home screen
capabilities.description: From a task row on the Home approval card, the manager taps one quick-action button (approve, forward, review or reject) that opens the shared action drawer for that task.

capabilities.name: Approve several tasks at once
capabilities.description: A manager long-presses to multi-select tasks (or selects all) in the approval list or on an employee's profile, sees totals per currency split by invoices/expenses/other, confirms and approves them in

capabilities.name: Review an employee's pending approval tasks
capabilities.description: On an employee's profile the manager expands Approval tasks (badge shows count) to see tasks that employee submitted, swipe a row for quick actions or multi-select them.

capabilities.name: Open the requester's employee profile from a task
capabilities.description: A manager jumps from an approval task or handled process to the HR profile of the employee who requested it.

capabilities.name: Comment on an approval process
capabilities.description: A manager adds a free-text comment to a task's process from the task screen; the draft is autosaved per task.

capabilities.name: View a task's attached documents
capabilities.description: A manager views a task's invoice/receipt attachments (PDF, image, TIFF, HTML) as thumbnails and full screen, zooms and pages with a page counter, switches documents, approves from the viewer footer, a

capabilities.name: Share or download a task document
capabilities.description: A manager exports a task's attachment(s) through the system share sheet; image attachments are combined into one PDF first.

capabilities.name: Browse my approval history
capabilities.description: A manager switches to the History tab to list processes they acted on, with status (awaiting, approved, rejected, cancelled), paging and pull-to-refresh, and opens a process.

capabilities.name: View a handled approval process
capabilities.description: A manager opens a history item to see document, company, amount, description, due date, resolution status, workflow history and Gaia hints.

capabilities.name: See a task's approval workflow and history
capabilities.description: A manager sees the workflow steps (initial source, current step with pending approvers, future/skipped steps, due dates) and the event history of a task or process.

capabilities.name: Approve or reject individual accounting lines
capabilities.description: An approver sets each voucher line of an expense/claim to approved or rejected; when all their lines are decided the matching approve/reject drawer opens automatically.

capabilities.name: Open a task's accounting lines
capabilities.description: From a task, a manager opens its voucher lines or Financials/Business NXT/Compello posting lines with a count of lines awaiting approval or editable, and switches between only their lines and all line

capabilities.name: Edit the accounting lines of an invoice before approving
capabilities.description: An approver edits the coding of an invoice's lines in the connected ERP (Visma.net Financials, Business NXT or Compello): text, accounts, subaccounts/org units, project and task, quantities, dates, ta

capabilities.name: Apply one field value to all lines
capabilities.description: While editing a field on one invoice line, the approver taps 'Apply to all lines' to copy that value onto every other line, pending save.

capabilities.name: Discard unsaved line edits
capabilities.description: The approver reverts all unsaved line changes after a confirmation, or confirms before leaving the line editor with unsaved changes.

capabilities.name: Choose which line fields to show
capabilities.description: The approver turns on Custom mode and picks which fields each invoice line shows; the choice is remembered across restarts.

capabilities.name: Jump to a specific invoice line
capabilities.description: On invoices with many lines, the approver taps a line number in a quick index rail to scroll to it and sees which lines have unsaved changes or errors.

capabilities.name: Receive push notifications on this device
capabilities.description: The device registers its push token with the backend so the person is notified: managers about new approval tasks, employees about new payslips, year-end reports, time-confirmation reminders, calendar

capabilities.name: Stop push notifications to this device when signing out
capabilities.description: When the person signs out, the device token is unregistered from the backend so notifications stop arriving on this phone.

capabilities.name: Open a push notification in the right place
capabilities.description: Tapping a push notification switches to the right account and company and opens the matching payslip, year-end report, time-confirmation/calendar view, message inbox or home.

capabilities.name: See that new HR notifications are waiting
capabilities.description: The start/home page shows an inbox button with a badge dot when the server reports new Dottie HR notifications; opening the inbox clears the badge.

capabilities.name: Read the combined message inbox
capabilities.description: An employee opens the inbox and sees one date-sorted list, newest first, of native calendar/expense messages and Dottie HR notifications with colleague avatars; it reloads when the device comes back o

capabilities.name: Dismiss a message from the inbox
capabilities.description: The employee removes a native inbox message (deleted on the server) or hides a Dottie HR notification from the list with the close button.

capabilities.name: Mark an HR notification as read
capabilities.description: From a Dottie notification's context/item menu, the employee marks it as read.

capabilities.name: Open a document notification and confirm it as read
capabilities.description: The employee taps a Dottie notification to open its external link or download and preview its document; for must-read documents they are asked to confirm reading after closing the preview.

capabilities.name: Read an important message from the employer or Visma
capabilities.description: An information, warning or error message published remotely for the employee is shown as a card on the start/home page, with an action link opened outside the app and a close action.

capabilities.name: Open the app's notification settings
capabilities.description: A person opens the system notification settings for the app from Settings.

capabilities.name: Review AutoPay payments waiting for my approval
capabilities.description: A manager (AutoPay approver) sees all bank payments waiting for approval, grouped by company and bank account, with balance, total due, pay date, reference, warning marker and salary or domestic type.

capabilities.name: Search AutoPay payments
capabilities.description: A manager opens a search bar on the AutoPay home and filters payments and accounts by free text. Recent searches are remembered and all accounts are shown expanded while a search is active.

capabilities.name: Select AutoPay payments for approval
capabilities.description: A manager ticks single payments, selects a whole bank account, or selects all salary payments in one tap. They see the selected count and amount, then press Approve to continue to signing or cancel th

capabilities.name: Approve selected AutoPay payments with bank two-factor signing (BankID)
capabilities.description: A manager sends the ticked payments for approval and signs them with BankID or bank 2FA in an embedded web page. They get a success toast, or return to the list if they cancel.

capabilities.name: Track the status of processed AutoPay payments (In progress / Deviation / In bank)
capabilities.description: On an Overview tab, a manager reviews payments from the last 60 days in three buckets (in progress, deviation, in bank). Each bucket shows a count, a colour-coded status and the approvals still missin

capabilities.name: View an AutoPay payment's details
capabilities.description: A manager opens a payment from the Payments list or the Overview list and sees its status, creditor and debtor, references, original pay date and amount, events, and the approvers still missing. Proce

capabilities.name: View the invoice document attached to an AutoPay payment
capabilities.description: A manager previews the invoice attachment as a thumbnail and opens it full screen, as a PDF or, if the PDF fails, as page images.

capabilities.name: Change the pay date of an AutoPay payment
capabilities.description: A manager picks a new pay date from a date picker on the payment details. Past dates cannot be chosen and read-only payments cannot be changed.

capabilities.name: Add, edit or delete a note on an AutoPay payment
capabilities.description: A manager writes, saves, changes or clears a free-text note on a payment.

capabilities.name: Review and verify AutoPay payment warnings
capabilities.description: A manager sees fraud and risk warnings on a payment (new or changed creditor or debtor, duplicate invoice, Inyett detection) and marks them verified, one at a time or all at once, or removes a verific

capabilities.name: Cancel an AutoPay payment
capabilities.description: A manager cancels a pending payment from its details screen after confirming a warning dialog. The payment then disappears from the list.

capabilities.name: Sign in with a Visma Connect account
capabilities.description: A person signs in through the Visma Connect web login (OAuth in a browser session), the app stores their tokens, loads who they are and what they may use, and lands them in the app.

capabilities.name: Stay signed in without logging in again
capabilities.description: The app silently renews access tokens with the refresh token, on launch, on return to the foreground and when a token is about to expire, for every account saved on the device.

capabilities.name: Be signed out and told why when the session ends
capabilities.description: When the session expires, is revoked or the token cannot be renewed, the person is signed out and shown a message explaining why.

capabilities.name: Handle an account with no access
capabilities.description: A person whose account has no usable roles or permissions is told so and cannot enter the app. They can only sign out.

capabilities.name: Log out
capabilities.description: A signed-in person logs out. The app revokes their tokens, unregisters push, clears local session data and returns to the login screen.

capabilities.name: Switch between saved accounts
capabilities.description: A person with several Visma accounts on the device picks one, from the login screen or from the account manager, to make it active. A still-signed-in account opens right away; a signed-out one opens t

capabilities.name: Add another account
capabilities.description: From the account manager a person signs in to one more Visma account. It is stored next to the existing ones and becomes the current account.

capabilities.name: Remove a saved account from the device
capabilities.description: In edit mode on the account list a person removes an account after confirming. The app revokes its tokens, unregisters push and deletes its local data.

capabilities.name: Switch between my employers
capabilities.description: An employee who works for several companies picks the active employer from the start or home page. The app then reloads with that company's data, permissions and features. When none is chosen yet, the

capabilities.name: Protect the app with Face ID, fingerprint or PIN
capabilities.description: During first start or from Settings, an employee turns on an app lock: device biometrics, the device screen lock (Android), or a 4-digit app PIN chosen twice. They can also skip it for later.

capabilities.name: Unlock the app with Face ID, fingerprint or PIN
capabilities.description: When the app starts or comes back with an active session, the employee unlocks it with biometrics, the device credential or the 4-digit app PIN, after a time-of-day greeting. They can also choose to l

capabilities.name: Turn off the app lock
capabilities.description: In Settings the employee switches off the 'open app with Face ID/fingerprint/PIN' toggle, confirms, and verifies once more. From then on the app opens without a lock.

capabilities.name: Switch the backend environment
capabilities.description: An internal tester unlocks a hidden environment picker on the login screen and points the app at another backend (production, stage/staging, sandbox), or switches back to production.

capabilities.name: Choose a sandbox environment at login
capabilities.description: With the sandbox environment selected on the login screen, a tester picks which sandbox (by colour) the app talks to, from the sandboxes currently available.

capabilities.name: See my vacation balances on the start page
capabilities.description: An employee sees their combined vacation and leave balances grouped with units.

capabilities.name: Preview a day timeline (prototype)
capabilities.description: An internal prototype screen shows an expandable week calendar with a day timeline of hardcoded sample events. It does not appear to be reachable by users.

capabilities.name: Fill in and edit a server-defined form
capabilities.description: The employee edits server-driven forms with typed fields, repeatable groups, validation and reveal/hide of sensitive values. The fragment says it is used by the Dottie employee-info feature.

capabilities.name: Browse payroll dialogues

capabilities.name: Start a new payroll dialogue
capabilities.description: A manager creates a conversation with a title, a company and an optional linked wage run, then lands in it.

capabilities.name: Read a payroll dialogue conversation
capabilities.description: A manager opens a dialogue or split, from the list or from a push notification, and reads its messages under a company and wage-run header. The dialogue is marked read.

capabilities.name: Browse wage-run splits of a dialogue
capabilities.description: A manager sees the splits of a wage-run dialogue grouped by approval status (rejected, for approval, approved) and opens one.

capabilities.name: Send a message in a payroll dialogue
capabilities.description: A manager writes and sends a message to a dialogue or split. Unsent drafts are kept per dialogue.

capabilities.name: Edit a sent dialogue message
capabilities.description: A manager long-presses one of their messages, edits its text and saves.

capabilities.name: Delete a dialogue message
capabilities.description: A manager long-presses a message and deletes it.

capabilities.name: Rename a dialogue or change its linked wage run
capabilities.description: A manager edits a dialogue's title and links, changes or unlinks its wage run. The edit menu opens from the dialogue context menu, prefilled with the current values.

capabilities.name: Mark a dialogue as completed or reactivate it
capabilities.description: From the dialogue context menu a manager marks a dialogue complete or re-enables a completed one.

capabilities.name: Delete a dialogue
capabilities.description: From the dialogue context menu a manager chooses Delete, confirms in a modal that warns the deletion cannot be undone, and sees a success or failure toast.

capabilities.name: Approve or reject a wage run
capabilities.description: Inside a wage-run dialogue or split that awaits approval, the manager approves or rejects the payroll run.

capabilities.name: View a payslip's details
capabilities.description: An employee opens a payslip to see payment date, net total, line items and the employer message. It opens from the list, from a start-page or home card, or from a new-payslip push notification.

capabilities.name: Download a payslip PDF
capabilities.description: From the payslip details an employee downloads the payslip document as a PDF from any tenant to preview or share it.

capabilities.name: Export all my payslips to one PDF
capabilities.description: An employee exports all their payslips as one document. If they have payslips from several companies they first pick a company. They then preview or open the document.

capabilities.name: Browse my year-end reports
capabilities.description: An employee switches to the year-end reports segment or tab to see the annual tax and income reports for their selected companies.

capabilities.name: View a year-end report
capabilities.description: An employee opens a year-end report to see its titled field and value lines. It opens from the reports list or from a year-end push notification.

capabilities.name: Download a year-end report PDF
capabilities.description: An employee downloads a year-end report as a PDF and previews, shares or opens it.

capabilities.name: Learn why I have no payslips
capabilities.description: When the payslip list is empty, the employee taps a link to open the payslips FAQ.

capabilities.name: Browse and search company documents
capabilities.description: An employee with Dottie access opens Documents and benefits from the profile menu and sees the organization's shared documents grouped by category, with read/unread status, new badge and must-read/sho

capabilities.name: Open a company document
capabilities.description: An employee opens an organization document, either downloading the file and previewing it or opening its external link in the app, optionally from the document's description/details sheet.

capabilities.name: Confirm reading a required company document
capabilities.description: After closing a must-read or should-read company document that is not yet read, the employee is asked to mark it as read; on confirm it is flagged read on the server and in the list, 'Maybe later' dis

capabilities.name: View and open my personal documents
capabilities.description: An employee lists their own HR documents grouped by category, searches them by name, reads a document's description and downloads it to open it.

capabilities.name: Browse employee benefits
capabilities.description: An employee browses the company's benefits grouped by category, searches them by name, body or supplier, opens a benefit's detail and follows its link to more information.

capabilities.name: Open and acknowledge a document from a notification
capabilities.description: From a document read-request, reminder or document-link notification, the employee opens the document (external link or download preview) and is then asked to mark it as read.

capabilities.name: Preview a downloaded image or PDF inside the app
capabilities.description: A person opens a downloaded or attached image or PDF full screen inside the app with pinch-to-zoom and pan, then closes it.

capabilities.name: Open a downloaded file in another app
capabilities.description: A person opens a downloaded attachment, year-end report or exported payslips in a viewer app chosen from the system chooser, e.g. from an Open snackbar, with a first-page PDF preview available in-app.

capabilities.name: Browse my unsent expenses in the expenses inbox
capabilities.description: The employee sees every unsent receipt, credit card transaction, mileage and allowance in one list, with a collapsible credit card section, per-row sync status, offline and no-permission states, and o

capabilities.name: Start a new receipt, mileage or allowance
capabilities.description: From the expenses list add menu or the start/home page quick actions, the employee starts a new receipt (camera), a mileage or an allowance. The start is blocked when templates are missing, and allowa

capabilities.name: Capture or import a receipt image or PDF
capabilities.description: The employee photographs a receipt with automatic edge or object detection, flash and cropping, or picks an image or PDF from the device, to start a receipt or add an attachment.

capabilities.name: Share a photo or PDF into the app to create an expense
capabilities.description: The employee shares an image or PDF from another app into the Employee app, picks an employer with expense access when needed, and continues in the receipt flow.

capabilities.name: Auto-fill a receipt from its image and get a suggested expense type
capabilities.description: A scanned or shared receipt is sent to the machine-learning service. It pre-fills date, amount, VAT, currency, kilometres, flight duration and route, and suggests an expense type. When the employee sa

capabilities.name: Create or edit a receipt
capabilities.description: The employee fills in or edits a receipt from its template (expense type, amount, date, VAT, purpose, flight duration and other fields), sees validation errors, and saves it as a draft in the inbox. T

capabilities.name: Enter a receipt in a foreign currency with an exchange rate
capabilities.description: The employee picks the receipt currency, with frequently used currencies first. The app fetches a suggested exchange rate for the date and converts the amount to the company currency. The same currenc

capabilities.name: Calculate driving distance for a kilometre receipt
capabilities.description: On a receipt with a kilometres field, the employee picks from and to places (with recent suggestions) and an optional return trip, and the app fills in the distance from a route calculation.

capabilities.name: Add or remove attachments on an expense
capabilities.description: From an expense's attachments sheet the employee adds more files (scan, photo or file) or removes an attachment after confirming, on a draft or on an item in an editable claim.

capabilities.name: View or download an expense attachment
capabilities.description: The employee opens a receipt image or PDF full screen (with zoom) and saves it to the device.

capabilities.name: Link a credit card transaction to a receipt (merge)
capabilities.description: The employee pairs one credit card transaction with one matching receipt, from the inbox merge mode or from an item's detail through a candidate list ranked as exact or possible match, and the two bec

capabilities.name: Delete an unsent expense
capabilities.description: The employee deletes a receipt, credit card transaction, mileage or allowance draft from the inbox or from its detail screen after confirming. It is deleted on the server, or only on the device if it

capabilities.name: Send selected expenses to a claim
capabilities.description: In the inbox the employee selects several valid, synced drafts (one by one, per section or all), the app validates them, and the employee picks an existing editable claim or creates a new one. Before

capabilities.name: Create a new expense claim from selected expenses
capabilities.description: The employee bundles selected receipts, mileages, allowances and card transactions into a new claim. They fill in title, comment, cost units and project, review the totals (reimbursable and paid by co

capabilities.name: Send an expense claim for approval
capabilities.description: The employee sends a new or existing claim, with any newly added expenses, to the approver. The claim is saved first, and a server-defined confirmation may be shown.

capabilities.name: Add new or existing expenses to a claim from the claim screen
capabilities.description: From an open claim, the employee creates a new receipt, mileage or allowance that is saved straight into the claim, or picks existing inbox drafts to add to it.

capabilities.name: Add a receipt, mileage or allowance to a claim from its form
capabilities.description: From a receipt, mileage or allowance form, the employee saves the item and adds it to a claim they pick, or saves it straight into the claim the form was opened from ('Save to <claim>').

capabilities.name: Send a single expense straight for approval
capabilities.description: From a receipt, mileage or allowance form, the employee sends that one item for approval without building a claim. A confirmation can be turned off with 'don't show again'. If the server rolls the ite

capabilities.name: Review an expense claim's details
capabilities.description: The employee opens a claim and sees its status, any status-change reason, the receipts, mileages and allowances grouped by category, the total, the amount paid by the company, and the actions the serv

capabilities.name: Edit a claim's title and comment
capabilities.description: The employee changes an open claim's title (description) and comment and saves them back to the claim.

capabilities.name: Withdraw a claim from approval
capabilities.description: The employee cancels the approval request of a claim they already sent, after an optional server-defined confirmation. The claim then reloads.

capabilities.name: Delete an expense claim
capabilities.description: The employee confirms and deletes a claim they no longer need, and the claim screen closes.

capabilities.name: View, edit or delete an item inside a claim
capabilities.description: From a claim, the employee opens a receipt, mileage or allowance. It is read-only when the claim cannot be changed, and can be edited, saved or deleted through the claim's links when it can.

capabilities.name: Assign cost units to an expense or claim
capabilities.description: The employee picks cost-allocation dimension values for a receipt, mileage, allowance or claim from searchable, paged lists (for eHRM companies, organization unit and position with defaults), optional

capabilities.name: Assign project accounting to an expense or claim
capabilities.description: In a company that uses project accounting, the employee picks a project, a dependent task and a reinvoice-on-project choice for a receipt, mileage, allowance or claim, using searchable paged pickers.

capabilities.name: Log a business-trip mileage and save it as a draft
capabilities.description: The employee fills in or edits a mileage from the company mileage template (date, vehicle and fuel type, trip type, purpose, distance, passengers, cost units, project) and saves it as a draft. When of

capabilities.name: Plan a mileage route and calculate its distance
capabilities.description: The employee sets a start point, destinations and waypoints by address search, map tap, current location or recent places. They can reorder stops and add a return trip, and the app fetches driving dir

capabilities.name: Calculate road tolls automatically for a mileage trip
capabilities.description: With automatic road-toll calculation on, the app sends the route with fuel type, rush-hour and AutoPASS settings and fills in the road toll amount, which the employee can edit or delete. Saving waits

capabilities.name: Remember my mileage defaults
capabilities.description: New mileages start with the employee's last fuel type, vehicle or trip type, rush-hour, AutoPASS and automatic road-toll choices, saved locally and on the server.

capabilities.name: Register or edit a travel allowance (per diem)
capabilities.description: The employee enters purpose, regular-day travel and one or more travel segments (start and end date-time, destination country, allowance type), continues to the per-day step, and saves a new allowance

capabilities.name: Set meals and lodging per travel day and see the calculated allowance
capabilities.description: On the second allowance step the employee sets breakfast, lunch, dinner or meal, lodging type and night allowance, either for all days or per day, and sees the server-calculated total, meal deduction

capabilities.name: Record hotel stays for an allowance and find the hotel
capabilities.description: The employee adds hotel stays to the allowance, which must be continuous and inside the server's lodging periods. They fill in each hotel by search or pick from recently used hotels, which they can re

capabilities.name: Read what allowances are and the company policy
capabilities.description: The employee opens a help sheet from an allowance field label that explains the allowance and period definitions, with a link to more documentation.

capabilities.name: View my travel emissions summary
capabilities.description: The employee sees this year's CO2 emissions from their expenses as a donut chart of top expense types with the change from the previous period, and can read how emissions are calculated and their limi

capabilities.name: See the CO2e emissions of an expense or claim
capabilities.description: On a receipt, mileage or claim, the employee sees the calculated CO2e emissions, when the company has emission details turned on.

capabilities.name: Keep expenses in sync and upload offline drafts automatically
capabilities.description: The app downloads the inbox, currencies and templates and uploads receipts and mileages saved locally while offline. It runs in the background when the connection returns, shows each item's upload sta
